data.title: Country Director DACH / Managing Director Germany (m/w/d)
data.description:
Standort: Deutschland (flexibel / hybrid)
Berichtet an: Executive Leadership Team
Verantwortungsbereich: Gesamtverantwortung für kommerzielles Wachstum, Organisationsentwicklung und Geschäftsergebnis in Deutschland in den Märkten Utility-Scale BESS sowie Community, Commercial & Industrial (CCI).

Über iwell
iwell ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter von intelligentem Energiemanagement und Batteriespeicherlösungen (Battery Energy Storage Solutions, BESS). Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, Energiekosten zu senken, den Energieverbrauch zu optimieren, ihre Resilienz zu erhöhen und die Energiewende zu beschleunigen. iwell hat eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in ganz Europa und eine etablierte Präsenz in Deutschland. Darauf aufbauend startet iwell in die nächste Wachstumsphase in einem der dynamischsten und strategisch wichtigsten Energiespeichermärkte des Kontinents.

Für diese Ambition sucht iwell eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Country Director / Managing Director Germany (m/w/d). Sie führen das deutsche Geschäft und treiben die weitere Expansion in zentralen Wachstumssegmenten voran.

Sie berichten direkt an das Executive Leadership Team und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für das deutsche Geschäft. Dabei vereinen Sie kommerzielle Führung, strategische Ausrichtung, Organisationsentwicklung und operative Steuerung. Sie treiben das Vertriebswachstum selbst voran. Sie stärken die Marktposition von iwell, skalieren die lokalen Aktivitäten und erreichen ambitionierte Wachstumsziele, stets in enger Abstimmung mit der übergeordneten Gruppenstrategie.


Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit: Sie führen einen der wichtigsten Märkte in der europäischen Wachstumsstrategie von iwell und tragen direkt zur Transformation des deutschen Energiesektors bei.

Die Chance
Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Wachstum in zwei strategischen Geschäftsbereichen:
Utility-Scale BESS
Ausbau der Präsenz von iwell bei großen Batteriespeicherprojekten. Dazu gehört der Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Projektentwicklern, EPC-Unternehmen, Investoren, Energieversorgern, unabhängigen Stromerzeugern (IPPs), Übertragungs- und Verteilnetzbetreibern sowie weiteren zentralen Stakeholdern im gesamten Energie-Ökosystem.
Community, Commercial & Industrial (CCI)
Beschleunigung des Wachstums bei dezentralen Energiespeicheranwendungen. Der Fokus liegt auf Branchen wie Verkehrs- und Logistikinfrastruktur, Mobilität und Flottenelektrifizierung, Gewerbeimmobilien, Industrieanlagen, Häfen und Rechenzentren. Hinzu kommen weitere energieintensive Standorte, die mehr Resilienz, Optimierung und Nachhaltigkeit in ihrer Energieversorgung anstreben.
Ihre Aufgabe ist es, die bestehende Marktdynamik in nachhaltiges kommerzielles Wachstum umzusetzen und eine High-Performance-Kultur zu fördern. Dabei stellen Sie sicher, dass das deutsche Geschäft eng an den strategischen Zielen der Gruppe ausgerichtet bleibt.

Ihre Aufgaben
Strategische Führung

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der langfristigen Geschäftsstrategie für Deutschland im Einklang mit den Zielen der Gruppe und den europäischen Wachstumsambitionen.

  • Definition und Umsetzung von Wachstumsplänen für die Geschäftsbereiche Utility-Scale BESS und CCI.

  • Identifikation neuer Marktchancen, Partnerschaften, Vertriebswege und Umsatzquellen im deutschen Energie-Ökosystem.

  • Festlegung von Jahresplänen, Budgets und Wachstumszielen für das deutsche Geschäft.

  • Direkter Beitrag zu übergreifenden europäischen Wachstumsinitiativen und zur Unternehmensstrategie.

Kommerzielles Wachstum & Marktentwicklung

  • Vorantreiben der weiteren Expansion des deutschen Geschäfts von iwell in den Märkten für Großbatteriespeicher (Utility-Scale) und dezentrale Batteriespeicher.

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen auf Senior-Ebene zu Projektentwicklern, EPCs, Energieversorgern, Aggregatoren, Infrastruktureigentümern, Investoren, strategischen Partnern sowie großen gewerblichen und industriellen Energieverbrauchern.

  • Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung kommerzieller Strategien, die nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum und steigende Marktanteile sichern.

  • Identifikation und Gewinnung strategischer Partnerschaften, die die Wettbewerbsposition von iwell stärken und das Wachstum beschleunigen.

  • Repräsentation von iwell als zentrales Gesicht des Unternehmens in der sich rasant wandelnden Landschaft der deutschen Energiewende.

Geschäftsführung & Operations

  • Gesamtverantwortung für Performance und Wachstum des deutschen Geschäfts.

  • Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz in Vertrieb, Projektabwicklung, Customer Success, Service und Support.

  • Etablierung wirksamer Strukturen für Governance, Performance-Management und Reporting.

  • Steuerung von Budgetierung, Forecasting, Ressourcenplanung und Profitabilitätszielen.

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Executive Leadership Team zur Geschäftsentwicklung und zu Markteinblicken.

Teamführung

  • Aufbau, Führung und Weiterentwicklung einer leistungsstarken deutschen Organisation, die ambitionierte Wachstumspläne tragen kann.

  • Rekrutierung, Mentoring und Bindung herausragender Talente in kommerziellen, operativen und kundennahen Funktionen.

  • Förderung einer Kultur von Verantwortung, Zusammenarbeit, Kundenorientierung und Exzellenz.

  • Sichtbare und inspirierende Führung mit unternehmerischer und hands-on Arbeitsweise.

Markt- & Stakeholder-Engagement

  • Vertretung von iwell auf Branchenkonferenzen, bei Kundenterminen, in Regierungsforen und in Branchenverbänden.

  • Aufbau von Beziehungen zu zentralen Stakeholdern im gesamten Ökosystem der deutschen Energiewende.

  • Fundiertes und aktuelles Verständnis von Marktentwicklungen, Regulierung, Trends im Energiespeicherbereich, Flexibilitätsmärkten und neuen Chancen.

Ihr Profil
Wir suchen eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, etwa als Country Leader, Managing Director, General Manager oder Senior Commercial Executive. Sie verbinden strategische Weitsicht mit ausgeprägtem kommerziellem Gespür und können Unternehmen im deutschen Energiewendesektor skalieren.

Erfahrung & Qualifikationen

  • Umfangreiche Führungserfahrung in den Bereichen Batteriespeicher, erneuerbare Energien, dezentrale Energie, Energieinfrastruktur, Ladeinfrastruktur für E-Mobilität, Flexibilitätsdienstleistungen, Smart Energy, Energiesysteme oder in angrenzenden Branchen.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in relevanten Kundensegmenten wie Transport, Logistik, Flottenelektrifizierung, Gewerbeimmobilien sowie Co-Location von erneuerbaren Energien und BESS.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Führung einer Ländergesellschaft, eines Geschäftsbereichs, einer regionalen Organisation oder einer wachstumsstarken kommerziellen Einheit.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wachstumsstrategien.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis des deutschen Energiemarkts, des regulatorischen Umfelds und der kommerziellen Dynamik.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb komplexer technischer Lösungen und infrastrukturbasierter Energieprodukte.

  • Starkes Netzwerk unter Projektentwicklern, Energieversorgern, EPCs, Investoren, Aggregatoren, gewerblichen und industriellen Kunden sowie weiteren Akteuren der Energiewende.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke Teams aufzubauen und zu führen.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Geschäftsergebnissen, Budgets, Forecasts und kommerziellen Zielen.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Persönliche Eigenschaften

  • Strategisch denkende und kommerziell versierte Führungskraft.

  • Unternehmerisch, wachstumsorientiert und hands-on.

  • Hohe Glaubwürdigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Senior Stakeholder intern wie extern zu überzeugen.

  • Ergebnisorientiert, mit ausgeprägten analytischen Fähigkeiten und Entscheidungsstärke.

  • Leidenschaft für die Energiewende und technologiegetriebene Innovation.

Warum iwell?

  • Führung eines der strategisch wichtigsten europäischen Märkte von iwell.

  • Aufbau auf einer etablierten Plattform und starker Marktdynamik, mit der Chance, die nächste Wachstumsphase aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Eine führende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der deutschen Energiewende durch innovative Batteriespeicherlösungen.

  • Einfluss auf die Strategie auf deutscher und europäischer Ebene, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Executive Leadership Team.

  • Langfristige Wertschöpfung durch das Wachstum einer äußerst ambitionierten und unternehmerischen Organisation.

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket auf Executive-Niveau mit wettbewerbsfähigem Grundgehalt, leistungsabhängigem Bonus und Beteiligung an der langfristigen Wertsteigerung.

Interesse geweckt?
Mehr über iwell, was wir tun, warum wir es tun, und einen Überblick über unsere Partner finden Sie unter https://iwell.eu/.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess
Bewerbung. Unser People & Culture Team und die einstellende Führungskraft prüfen Ihre Bewerbung und melden sich innerhalb von 2 Wochen bei Ihnen.
Telefonisches Erstgespräch. Sind Sie ein echter iweller-in-the-making? Wir laden Sie zu einem Kennenlerngespräch ein.
Sind Sie die richtige Person? Es folgen zwei oder mehr Interviews. Für einige Positionen bitten wir Sie zusätzlich, eine Fallstudie zu bearbeiten.

data.title: Portfolio Commercial Director
data.description:
WOULD YOU LIKE TO BE PART OF A FAST - GROWING ORGANISATION? 

JOIN US AS AREA COMMERCIAL DIRECTOR!

ABOUT ODYSSEY 

We're The Odyssey Hotel Group, Europe’s most ambitious hotel operator and the team behind many famous global hospitality names. We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop exceptional properties across various brands, from Holiday Express to Marriott's Autograph collection. Powered by over 800 employees and supported by Activum SG as our major shareholder, our purpose is to shape hospitality together!

ABOUT POSITION

The Portfolio Commercial Director is responsible for the overall commercial performance of a blended portfolio of full service hotels, strongly MICE driven hotels in key markets in Germany.

This role holds end-to-end accountability for commercial strategy and execution, covering Sales, Revenue Management, Distribution, and Marketing, with a strong focus on sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability, while ensuring alignment with owner expectations and long-term asset value creation.

As a senior commercial leader, the role acts as a trusted advisor to hotel owners and asset managers, delivering transparent, data-driven insights and ensuring that all commercial strategies support both short-term performance and long-term financial returns.

The position operates within a matrix organisation, partnering closely with Operations, Finance, and commercial discipline leaders to drive integrated commercial strategies across the portfolio.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute hotel-level commercial strategies aligned with overall business goals.

• Lead forecasting and budgeting processes to ensure accurate financial planning and performance tracking.

• Drive commercial initiatives at both the hotel and country levels to maximize total hotel revenue opportunities.

• Executive report on results and present business analytics to internal and external stakeholders.

• Act as primary commercial liaison with Hotel Operations, ensuring alignment between commercial and operational priorities.

• Oversee account management and achieving sales targets, maintaining strong customer and partner relationships.

• Manage pricing and inventory strategy, ensuring optimal yield and market competitiveness.

• Develop, manage, and recruit commercial team members, in close cooperation with the relevant commercial disciplinary leader, to build strong regional capabilities and performance.

• Lead structured owner communication, including monthly and quarterly reviews, clearly articulating performance drivers, risks, and opportunities

HOW YOU WILL DO IT

• Building strong and trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, Hotel Managers, and internal stakeholders.

• Applying sound commercial judgement and data-driven decision-making to drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability.

• Translating complex commercial performance data into clear business insights and actionable strategies.

• Aligning Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations around common business objectives.

• Proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and market trends and adapting commercial strategies accordingly.

• Providing clear direction, coaching, and support to commercial teams, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

• Influencing stakeholders at all levels through effective communication, collaboration, and executive presence.

• Maintaining a strong focus on owner satisfaction, long-term asset value creation, and sustainable business growth.

• Ensuring commercial excellence through structured planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and continuous improvement.

• Balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver measurable business results.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 5-8+ years of experience in hotel commercial leadership, across Sales, Revenue Management, or Commercial Operations

  • Proven experience in multi-property / regional roles

  • Strong track record in driving revenue growth, market share, and profitability

  • Deep expertise in:

    • Revenue Management (pricing, forecasting, distribution)

    • Commercial strategy and demand generation

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with hotel owners, asset managers, or investors

  • Strong analytical capability with ability to translate data into strategic insights

  • Experience presenting budgets, forecasts, and performance to senior stakeholders

  • Proven leadership in building and managing high-performing teams

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation

  • Results-driven mindset with focus on asset value and long-term performance

  • Full professional fluency in English and German (written and spoken)

What do we offer

  • A competitive salary with bonus plan

  • Holiday & Christmas bonus after 6 months

  • laptop, phone and appropriate travel compensation depending of what fits your needs

  • A diverse, multicultural, and dynamic work environment

  • Respective of your work scope, discounted stays at large branded hotels worldwide such as Marriott, IHG and all Odyssey properties

  • 30 vacation days from day one for a healthy work-life balance

  • Access to a health card to reimburse health related invoices - Health insurance card with €300 annual budget

  • Access to “Corporate Benefits” discounts

  • Ongoing training, personal growth opportunities, and priority access to internal vacancies.

  • €500 net referral bonus for new hires

data.title: AI-Native Software Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Dein Plus bei Health Dialog Solutions

Wir entwickeln Software, IT-Services und digitale Lösungen für Kassenärztliche Vereinigungen und Krankenversicherungen. Unsere Produkte helfen dabei, ambulante medizinische Versorgung zu steuern, zu digitalisieren und effizienter zu gestalten – für Millionen Patienten in Deutschland.

Mit über 25 Jahren Erfahrung im deutschen Gesundheitswesen und rund 300 Experten an deutschen Standorten verbinden wir tiefes Markt-Know-how mit moderner Technologie. Unsere Kunden setzen auf uns, weil wir die komplexen regulatorischen und operativen Anforderungen des Gesundheitsmarktes kennen und passgenaue Lösungen dafür liefern.

  • Greenfield: Du baust unseren AI-Coding-Stack von Grund auf – kein Legacy-Setup, keine Altlasten
  • Volle Gestaltungshoheit über Werkzeuge, Architektur und Prozess
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Mobile Office
  • Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im europäischen Ausland
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • JobRad: Fahrrad-Leasing zur beruflichen und privaten Nutzung
  • Attraktive MitarbeiterInnen-Rabatte
  • Offene Feedback-Kultur und individuelle Weiterbildung
  • Interdisziplinäre Aufgaben
  • Agile & digitale Unternehmensstrukturen
  • Über 20 Jahre Wissen & Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheitswelt
  • Mentoring & Wissensaustausch

Dafür brauchen wir Dich

  • AI-Coding-Stack: Du baust unseren internen Stack für agentische Softwareentwicklung von Grund auf – Auswahl, Konfiguration und Betrieb der Coding-Agent-Umgebung, bewusst modell- und anbieterneutral.
  • Testautomatisierung & Dokumentation: Du schließt unsere größten technischen Lücken: automatisierte Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests sowie agententaugliche technische Dokumentation im Repository.
  • Quality Gates: Du etablierst automatisierte Code-Reviews als festen Bestandteil unserer CI/CD-Pipeline und baust eine synthetische Test-Daten-Factory auf, die den gesamten Workflow aus dem DSGVO-Scope hält.
  • Aktive Entwicklung: Du entwickelst mit – rund die Hälfte Deiner Zeit baust Du reale Features über genau die Pipeline, die Du aufsetzt. Der Mix ist wellenförmig: Phasen intensiver Stack-Arbeit wechseln mit Phasen aktiver Entwicklung.
  • Governance: Du definierst die verbindlichen KI-Vorgaben für unsere externen Entwicklungsdienstleister und verantwortest das interne Quality Gate. Dabei führst Du kein Team – gefragt ist fachliche Autorität, keine disziplinarische.
  • Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest einen internen Kollegen ein, der die Rolle gemeinsam mit Dir trägt und den Stack langfristig mitverantwortet.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast rund 7-10 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung auf Senior- oder Lead-Niveau hinter Dir, mit Architekturverantwortung. Java und Spring Boot im Backend, idealerweise Angular im Frontend.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C1) und fließend Englisch und hast einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland.
  • Microservices, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL und CI/CD sind für Dich Alltag. Testautomatisierung hast Du nicht nur genutzt, sondern aufgebaut.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit agentischen Coding-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Codex und orchestrierst mehrere Agenten parallel. Jahreszahlen erwarten wir hier ausdrücklich nicht – diese Arbeitsweise gibt es erst seit Ende 2025.
  • Du pflegst eigene Kontext-Dateien, Skills und System-Prompts und kannst sie uns zeigen. Du hast eine belastbare Antwort darauf, wie Du agentengenerierten Code verifizierst.
  • Du kannst begründen, warum Du welches Werkzeug einsetzt – statt dem jeweils neuesten Trend zu folgen.
  • Du verstehst Business, nicht nur Technik, und kannst gegenüber externen Dienstleistern Standards setzen und durchsetzen.
  • Wünschenswerte Kenntnisse: Idealerweise hast Du bereits eine eigene agentische Entwicklungs-Pipeline aufgebaut – inklusive Review und Testing, beruflich oder privat. Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern sowie in der Steuerung externer Entwicklungsdienstleister ist von Vorteil.

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex compliance and regulatory data into clear, actionable insights that protect the business, satisfy regulators, and support senior leadership in making high-stakes decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error.

If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission!

 

The opportunity

  • Own the design of dashboards, compliance metrics, and regulatory reports, turning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and regional compliance officers

  • Automate end to end compliance related data solutions, governance controls, and automations to boost efficiency and minimize manual intervention

  • Dive into large, complex datasets to turn findings into scalable, audit-ready data models that facilitate regulatory reporting and analytics

  • Translate regulatory and business requests into accurate reports and automated data pipelines using Python, SQL, DBT and Airflow

  • Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources

  • Coordinate client data quality monitoring by identifying issues, flagging remediations, and partnering with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs

  • Deliver insights that shape compliance direction through clear, data-driven storytelling

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, with hands-on experience in compliance and regulatory reporting across frameworks such as AML, KYC, Sanctions, MiCA, or MiFID

  • Solid understanding of regulatory risk and the ability to operate effectively in high-scrutiny, audit-ready environments

  • Expert SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, and analytical functions, paired with proficiency in Python libraries such as pandas, matplotlib, and plotly

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration

  • Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, or Superset to build executive-facing dashboards

  • Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Alignment with the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

 

Nice to haves

Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

  • Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes.

  • Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive.

And we're already making a difference:

  • $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022.

  • Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database.

  • 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week.

  • Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb, alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam.


What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as People Operations Specialist and help us build a People function that’s simple, dependable, and able to scale!

💜 We are considering applications for both permanent and contract employment 💜


We're looking for someone to join us in building the next chapter of our People function at Goodstack.

Over the past four years, we've grown more than 8x, from 22 to around 200 Goodstackers across multiple countries. It's been an incredible journey, and with that kind of growth comes a whole lot of interesting challenges.

We've built a strong foundation, but there's plenty of opportunity to make the experience of working at Goodstack even better.

We're looking for someone who enjoys People Operations, gets satisfaction from making complicated things simple, and cares just as much about the little details as the bigger picture. Someone who understands good HR practices, takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs doing.

In this role, you'll have plenty of autonomy, the opportunity to shape how we work, and a close partnership with the Head of People as we continue scaling the function.


✍️ A note from the Head of People:

Hey, future Goodstacker! 👋

I don't expect you to know everything (who does?), but I do expect you to know your HR foundations, bring good judgement, take ownership and stay curious.

And if you're the kind of person who gets a little too excited about a beautifully organised process, I have a feeling we'll get along brilliantly!


As People Operations Specialist, your mission will be:

Making the Goodstacker experience brilliant

  • Own the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding and employment changes to offboarding, ensuring every experience is smooth, organised and thoughtful.

  • Prepare and quality-check employment contracts, amendments and other documentation, ensuring accuracy and alignment with applicable employment requirements.

  • Be the go-to person for day-to-day People questions, providing sound HR guidance, resolving routine matters independently and escalating more complex issues.

  • Partner with Talent, Finance, IT, managers and external providers to ensure smooth coordination across teams.

Keeping global People operations running smoothly

  • Coordinate payroll inputs, deadlines, employee benefits and employment changes across our locations.

  • Manage the operational administration of our international Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements.

  • Support right-to-work checks, immigration and sponsorship administration.

  • Apply HR policies and employment best practices consistently, identifying compliance risks and escalating them early.

  • Keep on top of statutory deadlines and employment obligations, working with external specialists when needed.

Making things better as we grow

  • Coordinate the operational delivery of performance reviews, progression and compensation cycles.

  • Maintain People reporting, policies, templates and internal documentation.

  • Use your HR knowledge to identify gaps in our processes and recommend practical improvements.

  • Find opportunities to simplify workflows and use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work.


What success looks like:

  • Every new Goodstacker has what they need before Day 1 and feels welcomed from the start.

  • Contracts, payroll inputs, employee changes and records are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Our people and managers can count on you for reliable advice, clear answers and helpful support.

  • You apply sound HR judgement, spot risks early and resolve routine matters without constant oversight.

  • Our People processes run smoothly, with fewer manual steps and less time spent chasing admin.

  • You proactively identify opportunities to strengthen compliance, consistency and the employee experience.

  • Ultimately, you're creating the operational reliability that allows us to spend more time improving the experience of working at Goodstack.


This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (AppSec)
data.description:
About us

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the role

You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.

Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one.

About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.

We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship.

What you’ll do

  • Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role.

  • Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening.

  • Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it.

  • Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look.

  • Vulnerability management. Run scanning and triage, own our vulnerability disclosure program, and handle incoming reports.

  • Automated quality. Own our security PR reviews, automated scans, fixes, and triage.

  • Write it down. Document how we do security so the rest of the team can answer customer questions with confidence.

  • Security habits. Help the engineering team build secure habits with reviews, docs, and light guardrails.

Like everyone at Trigger.dev, you’ll also help in our Discord and GitHub community, write docs, and create content like blog posts, code examples, and videos.

What we’re looking for

  • Senior backend engineer. You design and ship production backend systems yourself.

  • AppSec experience. You’ve done hands-on application security work, such as secure code review, threat modelling, pen testing, CTFs or bug bounties. You don’t need a security job title or to have run a security team.

  • Cloud operations. You’ve run production systems in the cloud.

  • Multi-tenant systems. You’ve built or secured systems where many customers share the same infrastructure.

  • TypeScript. You’re comfortable working in it. Our codebase also uses Go and Rust.

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools to automate testing, detection, and defense.

  • Startup pace. You’ve worked somewhere a step or two ahead of where we are, so you know what good looks like at our size.

  • Owner’s mindset. You take work off the team’s plate and fix what you find.

  • On call. Reliability and security response are shared across the team.

  • In-person time. You’re open to team events a few times a year.

You’ll stand out if you have

  • Built or hardened sandboxes: containers, microVMs, gVisor, Firecracker, WASM, or similar.

  • Secured platforms where customers have their own customers.

  • A track record in bug bounties or CTFs.

  • Contributed to open source.

  • Worked at a developer tools, infrastructure, or open source company.

  • Experience with Go or Rust.

Benefits

  • Compensation and equity. Generous, transparent pay, plus equity so everyone shares in the company’s success.

  • Async working. Need a heads-down day or a meeting-free day? No problem.

  • Home office. We help with equipment so you’re as productive at home as in the office.

  • Vacation. 25 days plus national holidays, sick leave, and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget. An annual budget for books, courses, or an Audible subscription.

  • Pension. Join our company scheme, or we’ll pay into your private pension.

Our values

  • We’re proud to be open source. We believe in the open source community and in building a great free-to-use product.

  • We ship uncomfortably fast. Moving fast is key for a startup. We’re pragmatic about what we build and when.

  • We work autonomously. We decide as a team what will help our customers most, and prioritize from there.

data.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Platform
data.description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Platform team. Platform powers every customer journey at Zego: the core services behind quoting, buying, paying for, changing, renewing and cancelling a policy.

You’ll own a product domain within Platform, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping refine the longer-term platform strategy as we rebuild and modernise some of Zego’s most critical services. You’ll turn technical challenges into business value, and make sure your services are resilient, compliant and ready to be used by AI agents as well as our apps.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term plans for Platform, balancing new capability, legacy rebuilds and reliability.

  • Lead complex discovery autonomously as we modernise the policy lifecycle, moving capability off legacy systems one safe slice at a time.

  • Dive deep into technical detail, understanding dependencies and failure modes, and making informed trade-offs with engineering.

  • Treat internal teams as your customers, so launching a new product, price or journey on the platform is fast and predictable.

  • Make your services AI-ready, with clean, well-documented APIs and data that agents and automations can use safely, and establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain.

  • Put the right metrics in place, from reliability and incidents to time-to-launch and cost to serve, and build the business case for platform investment.

  • Build compliance in from day one with Legal, Compliance and Finance, so money flows and customer communications are accurate and auditable.

  • Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Platform product ownership. A track record of owning a technical, platform or backend product domain and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

  • Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on system architecture, APIs, event-driven services and workflow orchestration. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

  • Legacy modernisation. You’ve led incremental rebuilds of business-critical services while keeping the lights on.

  • Data and commercial fluency. You use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground decisions, query Snowflake or Looker yourself, and can build the case for platform investment.

  • Clarity in complexity. You untangle dependencies across multiple business domains and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Regulated environment. Ideally, experience in insurance, payments, lending or financial services, with compliance built into product design.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Mobile Experience team. Our apps are where customers live with us day to day - recording trips, seeing their driving rating, managing their policy and getting help. For most of our customers, the app is Zego.

You’ll own a product domain within our apps, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping shape the longer-term direction of the Mobile Experience. You’ll lead discovery and delivery across iOS and Android, and use AI both to move faster and to build smarter experiences.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term plans for the Mobile Experience.

  • Lead complex discovery autonomously, from customer research and design partnerships to opportunity solution trees and business cases.

  • Craft mobile experiences customers prefer, from effortless onboarding to intuitive self-serve, that also cost less to serve.

  • Validate before you build, using A/B tests, feature flags, staged rollouts and rapid prototypes to back or kill ideas early.

  • Ship at pace in reusable building blocks across iOS and Android, working with engineering, design, data and compliance.

  • Put the right metrics in place, from adoption and retention to app ratings and stability, and use them to drive continuous improvement.

  • Establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain, and explore AI-powered experiences inside the app.

  • Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Mobile product ownership. A track record of owning a consumer mobile app, or a major area of one, and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

  • UX and customer instinct. You sweat the details of onboarding, permissions, notifications and accessibility, and know what makes great mobile experiences work.

  • Experimentation mindset. Hands-on experience with A/B tests, feature flags and rapid prototypes. You default to evidence over opinion.

  • Data and commercial fluency. Comfortable instrumenting events and analysing funnels in Amplitude, Looker or Snowflake, and building a business case around expected ROI.

  • Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on native vs cross-platform trade-offs, APIs and release management. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

  • Ownership and communication. A bias for action, and the ability to bring stakeholders with you across multiple teams.

data.description:
What We’re All About.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a commercially minded and technically strong finance professional to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

What you’ll be doing.

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

What you’ll bring.

Finance Process Transformation & Operational Excellence

  • Assist in the design and implementation of the Finance Target Operating Model (TOM), covering processes, systems and data, providing input and recommendations to support the overall TOM design.

  • Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap aligned to business objectives, operational efficiency, governance requirements and future compliance needs, including SOX readiness.

  • Analyse and redesign finance processes to improve productivity, control effectiveness and user experience.

  • Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies, developing practical and prioritised remediation plans.

  • Establish robust data governance, validation and reporting frameworks to improve the quality, consistency and reliability of financial information.

  • Map and optimise end-to-end transaction flows across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Support the creation of scalable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide meaningful operational and financial insight.

Finance Systems & Automation

  • Lead finance systems and automation projects from initial requirements through to implementation and post-go-live stabilisation.

  • Partner with Finance and Technology teams to evaluate, select and implement solutions that support future-state finance operations.

  • Drive automation opportunities across close processes, journal management, reconciliations, variance analysis and reporting.

  • Ensure data integrity, auditability and control considerations are embedded within all system and process changes.

  • Establish governance standards for financial data, system ownership and ongoing process maintenance.

Programme Delivery & Change Management

  • Apply disciplined project and programme management practices including planning, risk management, benefits tracking, stakeholder communication and delivery governance.

  • Define success measures and ensure transformation benefits are tracked, validated and sustained over time.

  • Build engagement and buy-in across the finance organisation by clearly communicating objectives, priorities and expected outcomes.

  • Support teams through process, technology and organisational change, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working.

  • Translate complex finance, operational and technology challenges into clear and actionable implementation plans.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Legal, Operations and commercial functions to align transformation priorities with wider business objectives.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on finance process, controls, systems and operating model design.

  • Work alongside finance teams to resolve complex operational challenges, improve processes and implement best practices.

  • Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on programme progress, risks, benefits realisation and key transformation milestones.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence across the finance function.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential.

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, ICAS, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience operating at Head of Finance / Financial Controller level, with broad oversight of the full accounting cycle (AP through to management accounts).

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-GAAP statutory accounting across multiple entities/jurisdictions.

  • Deep understanding of controllership processes: financial close cycles, account reconciliation, consolidation, intercompany accounting, journal entry management, and statutory reporting.

  • Track record of successfully leading financial systems/process implementation projects (e.g. ERP implementation, close process redesign, close automation tooling).

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement future-state close operating models covering process, automation, controls, data, and people.

  • Strong project management skills and experience, ideally with formal methodology exposure (e.g. Agile, Prince2, or similar).

  • Experience leading teams through significant change, with a genuine ability to bring people along on the journey.

  • Comfortable being hands-on and detail-oriented while also operating strategically.

Desirable.

  • Hands-on implementation or advisory experience with one or more close automation or EPM platforms (e.g. FloQast, BlackLine, OneStream, Prophix, or comparable).

  • Experience in a fast-growing, multi-entity, international business (SaaS/technology sector a plus).

  • Experience with modern finance/ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and reporting/automation tools.

  • Familiarity with the intersection between close quality, internal controls, and external audit.

  • Prior experience partnering with Legal, HR, and commercial teams on cross-functional finance matters.

  • PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification, or a Lean Six Sigma qualification.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Well-being days

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

data.title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
data.description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Callosum believes that scaling heterogeneous AI infrastructure requires understanding how emerging hardware will behave as part of larger computational systems. Performance characteristics measured on individual accelerators rarely translate directly to distributed deployments, where networking, memory, and execution strategies introduce new constraints. We are developing simulation infrastructure that allows us to explore these interactions and evaluate future systems before they exist.

This role advances the simulation and performance modelling tools that inform Callosum's hardware and infrastructure decisions. You will extend models that project device-level performance to rack-scale systems, explore alternative hardware configurations and execution strategies, and provide experimental environments for automated optimisation. The work also encompasses profiling, workload tracing, and performance instrumentation, connecting measurements from real systems to accurate and useful models of those we want to build.

What You'll Build

  • Extend our simulators to predict heterogeneous compute performance from individual accelerators to multi-rack deployments.

  • Model networking, memory, and execution behaviour to evaluate alternative system architectures and configurations.

  • Develop profiling, tracing, and workload capture tools that inform and validate simulation models.

  • Extend simulation environments for rapid experimentation and automated optimisation of systems and algorithms.

  • Characterise emerging accelerator architectures and translate hardware measurements into predictive models of system-level performance.

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong experience in systems simulation, performance modelling, or performance-critical systems software.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, distributed systems, or high-performance computing.

  • Familiarity with profiling, tracing, instrumentation, and methods for characterising computational workloads.

  • Strong systems programming experience, ideally including C++ or Rust.

  • Ability to reason about modelling accuracy, abstraction, and trade-offs between simulation fidelity and computational cost.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience

  • Equity & Ownership

  • Private healthcare

  • We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Callosum believes that the next generation of AI systems will emerge from models and hardware being optimised together. Today's model architectures have largely evolved around the capabilities of conventional GPUs, leaving significant opportunities unexplored as new accelerator architectures emerge. We are building infrastructure that allows models to be adapted to different computational substrates, rather than treating them as fixed algorithms that hardware must accommodate.

This role explores how model architectures and inference algorithms can be adapted to exploit heterogeneous hardware, creating specialised variants with different trade-offs between capability, latency, and cost. You will investigate transformations spanning numerics, sparsity, model structure, memory, and execution, alongside new algorithms designed around emerging accelerators. A central part of the work is developing automated approaches to these adaptations and rigorous evaluations that establish when the resulting models offer meaningful advantages.

What You'll Build

  • Develop hardware-aware transformations that adapt models to different accelerator architectures and execution environments.

  • Explore numerical, structural, and memory-related optimisations to create model variants with different capability, latency, and cost trade-offs.

  • Investigate new inference algorithms, including speculative decoding, designed to exploit heterogeneous computational resources.

  • Develop automated methods for discovering, characterising, and optimising hardware-specialised model variants.

  • Build evaluation methods that measure model quality and establish the trade-offs introduced by hardware-aware adaptations.

What Sets You Apart

  • Deep understanding of modern LLM architectures, including attention mechanisms, model structure, and their implications for inference.

  • Experience in model architecture research, efficient inference, or hardware-aware machine learning.

  • Familiarity with a range of architectures, such as mixture-of-experts, diffusion, JEPA, or alternative attention mechanisms.

  • Strong intuition for the interactions between model capability, numerical behaviour, memory requirements, and execution efficiency.

  • Experience designing rigorous experiments to assess model quality, efficiency, and the effects of architectural modifications.

  • We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us

We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all.

data.description:
Consumer Insights & Strategy Director
London - Hybrid (3 days per week in the office)

About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen.

How We Work

Our hybrid work style (3 days in the London office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions and build relationships. And it's flexible enough to give you the space to do your best work.

Consumer Insights & Strategy Director

The team

The Insights & Strategy team creates deep organizational understanding of our customers, markets and competitors so we can develop customer-centric products, services and communications that drive business growth.

We bring together different research disciplines and synthesize insights from across data sources, to tell coherent customer stories and ground decisions in evidence across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams. (Norton, Avast, MoneyLion & LifeLock)

Role summary

The Consumer Insights & Strategy Director is a senior individual contributor who acts as a strategic advisor to segment and brand leadership for either Cyber Safety (Norton & Avast) and Trust-based Solutions (LifeLock & MoneyLion).

Their primary responsibility is not to generate research, but to help the business make better decisions. They connect customer understanding, market dynamics, competitive context and commercial performance to shape growth strategy, portfolio choices, proposition development and customer experience priorities.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, customer insight and stakeholder leadership. You will:

  • Sit as a virtual member of the segment/brand leadership team, bringing the voice of the customer into key decisions.

  • Frame and scope the critical questions the business needs to answer.

  • Synthesize diverse inputs into clear, actionable narratives that influence direction.

  • Shape and prioritise the learning agenda for your segment in partnership with the wider Insight team.

Success is measured by the quality of business decisions influenced, not the volume of research delivered.

Key responsibilities

  1. Strategic business partnering

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Segment Lead / Brand Lead and their virtual leadership team on segment strategy, performance, customer base and competitive context for your business segment.

  • Frame and refine critical business questions (e.g., portfolio choices, proposition direction, target audiences, pricing/packaging, experience priorities).

  • Bring a customer- and evidence-centred perspective into business planning, roadmap discussions and major investment or trade-off decisions.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in key forums - challenging constructively, highlighting risks and opportunities, and helping leaders see decisions through a customer lens.

  1. Business strategy & decision support

  • Synthesize evidence from multiple sources - including customer insight, analytics, CX, market intelligence, commercial performance and external trends - into clear strategic recommendations for the business.

  • Develop compelling "so what / now what" narratives, presentations and workshops that help leaders and teams move from evidence to decision, creating clarity and alignment around key priorities.

  • Support stakeholders in evaluating strategic options and trade-offs relating to growth, customer experience, proposition development, portfolio choices and go-to-market decisions.

  • Ensure major insight programmes and strategic initiatives result in tangible business action, helping teams translate customer understanding into priorities, plans and measurable outcomes.

  1. Learning agenda and insight activation

  • Work closely with stakeholders and Insight team colleagues to ensure projects are framed against the right strategic questions for your segment.

  • Define and maintain a prioritised learning roadmap for your business area, aligned to the biggest opportunities, risks and decisions.

  • Spot knowledge gaps and emerging questions and translate them into clear briefs and programmes of work.

  • Act as a connector across functions and disciplines - joining up signals across teams and sources into a unified view of customer needs and market dynamics.

  • Play a leading role in developing the quarterly State of Play (integrated customer narrative) in collaboration with Insight team colleagues.

Skills & experience

Essential experience

  • Significant experience in customer insight, strategy, consulting or a closely related field, ideally in consumer technology, subscription, financial services or adjacent categories.

  • Proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholders on major strategic or commercial decisions (e.g., portfolio strategy, brand positioning, proposition development, experience design, go-to-market).

  • Experience synthesising multiple data and insight sources (qual, quant, analytics, CX, market intel) into concise, decision-ready outputs.

  • Demonstrated impact in turning insight into action - influencing real changes in products, experiences, communications or commercial strategy.

Skills & capabilities

  • Strategic, structured thinker - able to frame problems, prioritise questions, and connect customer insight to business outcomes.

  • Strong storytelling and communication - comfortable simplifying complexity, building clear narratives and presenting confidently to senior audiences.

  • Commercially astute - understands how brands grow, how P&Ls work, and how customer behaviour shows up in performance metrics.

  • Collaborative and credible - able to work effectively across teams, building trust and alignment in a matrix environment.

  • Influential without authority - willing and able to challenge thinking, propose alternatives and guide teams towards more customer-centric choices.

Mindset

  • Customer-obsessed - motivated by building a truthful, nuanced view of our customers and using it to drive better decisions.

  • Insight-to-action oriented - focused on impact, not just analysis; always asking "so what?" and "now what?".

  • Low-ego, high ownership - comfortable operating autonomously, rolling up their sleeves, and taking responsibility for outcomes in their segment.

What's Next

Your CV will be reviewed together by the recruiter and hiring manager to assess the scope of your role, the impact you've delivered, and how your experience aligns with the position. If shortlisted, the recruiter will invite you to an initial Zoom conversation to discuss your background, what's compelling you to Gen, and walk you through the interview process.

Gen is an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to fair, inclusive practices at every stage of the candidate and employee journey. Employment decisions are based on merit, experience and business needs.

Benefits


At Gen Digital, we are committed to supporting our employees’ well-being and professional growth. Our comprehensive benefits package for UK team members includes:

  • Health & Wellbeing – Company-paid private medical insurance, dental and vision benefits, plus access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).

  • Financial Security – A Group Personal Pension Plan with auto-enrolment for eligible employees, together with the opportunity to purchase Gen stock through our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off – available once statutory annual leave has been used, plus company holidays and a range of leave options to support personal and family needs.

  • Tuition Reimbursement – Up to £5,150 per calendar year for job-related accredited courses that support career development within Gen.

  • Wellness Reimbursement – Up to $450 per year to cover fitness-related expenses.

  • Sustainability Allowance – A $500 annual sustainable home improvement allowance.

  • Additional Perks – Access to adoption assistance, family support services, legal assistance plans, and exclusive employee discounts.

data.description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Researcher to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.
